lead: Solar Basking Spotlight 75W - focused heat and light for the basking spot in a terrarium.

description.html: The 75W Arcadia Solar Basking Spotlight is the mid-range option in the series, suitable for medium-sized terrariums and species that need a solid amount of heat at the basking spot. It produces focused heat and visible light that simulates sunlight in natural habitats.

Place it on one side of the terrarium to create a temperature gradient - a warmer basking zone and a cooler zone for resting. The E27 socket allows easy installation in standard ceramic holders. We recommend using it with a thermostat for precise temperature control.
Arcadia is a renowned British brand known for quality reptile lighting.
